recognize_zh: 骨髓中的漿細胞與淋巴漿細胞樣細胞，細胞質內有多個大小不一、邊界清楚的透明大空泡（B、C 特別明顯）；免疫固定電泳只見 μ 重鏈的帶（箭頭）而無對應 κ 或 λ 輕鏈，是 μ 重鏈病的典型組合。
features: Aspirate (A, B): plasma cells and lymphoplasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Multiple large, sharply defined, clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, sometimes indenting the nucleus
Cytochemical stain (C): cytoplasm stains pink-red around unstained empty vacuoles
Immunofixation (D): abnormal band in the anti-mu lane (arrow) without a corresponding kappa or lambda band
Immunoelectrophoresis (E): abnormal precipitin arc in the M region lacking light-chain reactivity (double arrow)
describe_en: Composite figure. The bone marrow aspirate contains plasma cells and lymphoplasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm that harbor multiple large, sharply defined clear vacuoles, as further highlighted on a cytochemical stain in which the vacuoles remain unstained. Serum immunofixation shows an abnormal band reacting with anti-mu antiserum without an associated kappa or lambda band, and immunoelectrophoresis shows an abnormal mu arc lacking light-chain reactivity. Findings are consistent with mu heavy chain disease, typically associated with a CLL-like or lymphoplasmacytic B-cell neoplasm with characteristic vacuolated plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with Mott cells or Russell bodies
ddx.vs: Mott cells contain multiple pale blue-pink immunoglobulin globules rather than empty clear vacuoles, and myeloma produces an intact monoclonal immunoglobulin or free light chain.
WM shows an IgM band with a matching kappa or lambda light chain and Dutcher bodies, not isolated mu chain.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia with plasmacytoid features
ddx.vs: CLL lacks prominent large clear vacuoles and does not produce free mu heavy chain on immunofixation.
Alpha HCD involves the small intestine (IPSID) and immunofixation shows an alpha-chain band without light chain.
